articles.title: Iluminar caminho longo sem transformar o quintal em vitrine | G1
articles.standfirst: Excesso de luz atrapalha a visão noturna e incomoda o vizinho. Veja como distribuir postes num percurso longo com luz suficiente e nada além
articles.summary: Excesso de luz atrapalha a visão noturna e incomoda o vizinho. Veja como distribuir postes num percurso longo com luz suficiente e nada além
articles.body:
Em propriedade com caminho longo — da porteira até a casa, ou da casa até o galpão — a tentação é resolver com potência: poucos pontos muito fortes. O resultado é o oposto do pretendido: zonas de ofuscamento alternadas com trechos escuros, visão noturna prejudicada e luz invadindo o terreno vizinho. Iluminar percurso é questão de distribuição, não de potência.

Postes coloniais para jardim: distribuição de pontos ao longo do percurso — Foto: Divulgação / Panela de Ferro Fundido

O olho se adapta ao ponto mais claro do campo de visão. Um poste muito forte faz a pupila fechar, e todo o resto — inclusive o trecho de caminho logo à frente — passa a parecer mais escuro do que é. É o mesmo efeito do farol alto de um carro vindo em sentido contrário. Vários pontos moderados iluminam melhor que poucos pontos fortes.

O olho se adapta ao ponto mais claro: um poste forte faz o resto do caminho parecer mais escuro do que é.

1.M eça o comprimento do caminho e o diâmetro de luz que cada modelo projeta no chão.

2.P osicione os postes para que os c írculos de luz quase se toquem — sem trecho escuro entre eles.

3.P refira m ais pontos com potência moderada a poucos pontos fortes.

4.E m curva, coloque um ponto n o início da curva, onde a visão precisa antecipar.

5.A lterne os lados em caminho largo, em vez de enfileirar tudo de um lado.

• Prefira luminária com c orpo fechado no topo, que joga luz para baixo.

• Evite globo aberto perto da divisa: ele espalha em todas as direções.

• Direcione o facho para dentro do terreno, nunca para a estrada ou o vizinho.

• Luz apontada para cima ilumina o céu e não ajuda ninguém a caminhar.

Vale planejar a distribuição no papel antes de abrir vala para o cabeamento. Os postes coloniais para jardim vêm em vários modelos e alturas.

Sediada em Divinópolis , no Centro-Oeste de Minas, a Panela de Ferro Fundido trabalha com postes, balizadores e iluminação externa. Os modelos estão no catálogo de postes para jardim , com entrega para todo o Brasil.

articles.title: Homem é preso suspeito de estuprar adolescente, filmar crime e compartilhar vídeo nas redes sociais | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo a polícia, Nicolas Archanjo Silva fazia parte de grupo que atraía vítimas para obter conteúdo íntimo e as ameaçava com a divulgação das imagens.
articles.summary: Segundo a polícia, Nicolas Archanjo Silva fazia parte de grupo que atraía vítimas para obter conteúdo íntimo e as ameaçava com a divulgação das imagens.
articles.body:
Nicolas é investigado por crimes como estupro de vulnerável e maus-tratos a animais. — Foto: Montagem/g1/Reprodução

Um homem de 21 anos investigado por estuprar uma adolescente, filmar o crime e compartilhar o vídeo nas redes sociais foi preso na segunda-feira (14), na região da Vila Curuçá, na Zona Leste de São Paulo .

Segundo a polícia, Nicolas Archanjo Silva foi identificado após uma denúncia e era conhecido como “monstro da Zona Leste”. A prisão foi realizada por policiais do 67º Distrito Policial (Jardim Robru), com apoio do Núcleo de Observação e Análise Digital (NOAD).

A investigação aponta que o suspeito fazia parte de um grupo que atuava em plataformas digitais, como o Telegram, atraindo jovens e mulheres para o envio de conteúdo íntimo. De acordo com a polícia, depois de obter as imagens, os integrantes ameaçavam divulgá-las e exigiam que as vítimas cumprissem tarefas degradantes.

Entre as ações impostas pelo grupo, segundo a investigação, estavam cortes no próprio corpo, escrever nomes com sangue e mutilar animais de estimação.

No caso investigado, a vítima relatou à polícia que foi atraída para a casa do suspeito. Segundo o depoimento, ela recebeu bebidas alcoólicas que a deixaram inconsciente e, nesse estado, foi estuprada e filmada.

A vítima reconheceu o suspeito, de acordo com a polícia. A Justiça decretou a prisão temporária de Nicolas por 30 dias. Durante esse período, os investigadores devem apurar a existência de outras possíveis vítimas.

Ao fim do prazo, a polícia informou que pretende pedir a conversão da prisão temporária em preventiva.

Nicolas é investigado por estupro de vulnerável, maus-tratos a animais e outros crimes. O g1 tenta localizar a defesa dele.

articles.title: 'Um dos dias mais felizes da minha vida', diz comissária que perdeu 6 voos e, no 7º, encontrou Demi Lovato | G1
articles.standfirst: Júlia Oliveira Tavares, de 25 anos, é fã da cantora desde os 12 e conseguiu encontrá-la por acaso durante voo para São Paulo, onde a artista tem apresentações nesta semana.
articles.summary: Júlia Oliveira Tavares, de 25 anos, é fã da cantora desde os 12 e conseguiu encontrá-la por acaso durante voo para São Paulo, onde a artista tem apresentações nesta semana.
articles.body:
Júlia Tavares com a cantora Demi Lovato — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

A segunda-feira (14) parecia ter tudo para dar errado para a comissária de voo Júlia Oliveira Tavares, de 25 anos. Ela estava no Rio de Janeiro e precisava voltar para São Paulo , onde mora. Depois de tentar embarcar em seis voos diferentes e não conseguir vaga em nenhum deles, chegou a chorar de nervoso na sala de embarque e pensou em desistir.

Na sétima tentativa, finalmente conseguiu embarcar. E quando ela abriu o compartimento de bagagem, deu de cara com ninguém menos que sua ídola, Demi Lovato , que também seguia para São Paulo após se apresentar no Rock in Rio.

Fã da cantora desde os 12 anos, Júlia não imaginava que a sequência de voos perdidos terminaria justamente no encontro que esperava havia mais de uma década. O relato publicado por ela nas redes sociais viralizou e já rendeu mais de 700 comentários e milhares de curtidas.

Ao g1 , Júlia contou que, como comissária, pode embarcar em voos desde que tenha feito o check-in e existam assentos disponíveis, tanto de passageiros quanto de tripulantes. Por isso, o embarque não é garantido. Naquele dia, ela tentou seis voos diferentes, mas não encontrou vaga em nenhum deles.

A espera fez com que ela precisasse cancelar um compromisso.

“Literalmente chorei na sala de embarque de nervoso porque precisei cancelar um compromisso devido à demora para achar uma vaga. Eu já estava até considerando voltar para a casa dos meus pais, no Rio, e tentar de novo no dia seguinte”, contou.

Antes de embarcar, diante da sequência de contratempos, Júlia chegou a brincar com uma amiga que enviou uma foto da cantora perguntando se ela chegou a ver a cantora no aeroporto. Ela, então, respondeu: “Você acha que algo de bom está acontecendo comigo hoje?”

Mensagem que Júlia respondeu antes de encontrar com Demi Lovato — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

A comissária decidiu fazer uma última tentativa para voltar à capital paulista, em um voo que decolaria pouco depois. Desta vez, conseguiu uma vaga.

“Quando fui guardar minhas coisas do compartimento de bagagem dei de cara com a Demi”, relatou.

Júlia contou que perguntou a Demi se poderia abraçá-la. A cantora autorizou. Depois de tirar uma foto com a artista, a comissária contou para a cantora que ela era o motivo pelo qual havia aprendido inglês.

“Ela abriu um sorrisão quando eu disse que aprendi na intenção de conversar com ela um dia e disse: ‘You manifested it, I'm so happy to meet you [você tornou isso real. Estou muito feliz em te conhecer]’”, contou.

Júlia diz que é fã de Demi desde seus 12 anos. Em 2014, ainda adolescente, ela foi a um show da cantora no Rio durante a “The Neon Lights Tour”. Uma foto daquela época foi compartilhada por uma amiga nas redes sociais nesta quarta-feira (16).

E mais de uma década depois, a fã encontrou a cantora de uma maneira que dificilmente poderia ter planejado: em um voo comercial, justamente depois de passar horas tentando voltar para casa. "Um dos dias mais felizes da minha vida", ressaltou.

Júlia Tavares com as amigas em 2014 durante show da Demi Lovato em 2014 — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

articles.title: Homem de capacete invade loja e mata funcionário a tiros em Anapu, no Pará | G1
articles.standfirst: Câmera de segurança registrou o momento em que o criminoso entrou armado no estabelecimento, foi até a vítima e fez pelo menos cinco disparos.
articles.summary: Câmera de segurança registrou o momento em que o criminoso entrou armado no estabelecimento, foi até a vítima e fez pelo menos cinco disparos.
articles.body:
Um homem foi morto a tiros enquanto trabalhava em uma loja de peças de motocicletas, em Anapu , no sudoeste do Pará. Uma câmera de segurança registrou o momento em que um homem de capacete entrou armado no estabelecimento e atirou contra a vítima.

Nas imagens, o criminoso entra na loja e segue em direção ao funcionário, que estava de costas. Em seguida, faz pelo menos cinco disparos contra a vítima.

Uma equipe do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) foi acionada, mas o funcionário morreu no local.

O caso é investigado pela Delegacia de Anapu, que tenta identificar o autor dos disparos e outros possíveis envolvidos no homicídio.

articles.title: Mateus Simões defende redução de espera por cirurgias em Minas | G1
articles.standfirst: Candidato do PSD à reeleição participou de encontro sobre saúde pública em Belo Horizonte. Ele também defendeu a realização de mais exames em unidades básicas de saúde.
articles.summary: Mateus Simões propõe agilizar cirurgias eletivas em Minas e ampliar a oferta de exames em unidades básicas para acelerar diagnósticos na rede pública de saúde.
articles.body:
Mateus Simões (PSD) participou de um encontro sobre saúde pública no bairro Ipiranga, na Região Nordeste de Belo Horizonte — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Mateus Simões (PSD), candidato à reeleição ao governo de Minas Gerais, participou nesta quarta-feira (16) de um encontro sobre saúde pública no bairro Ipiranga, na Região Nordeste de Belo Horizonte .

Durante o evento, Mateus afirmou que, se reeleito, pretende aprimorar o modelo de realização de cirurgias eletivas no estado para reduzir o tempo de espera dos pacientes.

O candidato também defendeu ampliar a realização de exames nas Unidades Básicas de Saúde (UBSs). A proposta é permitir que procedimentos como hemograma, exame de urina e eletrocardiograma sejam feitos na própria unidade durante o atendimento.

"A pessoa vai na UBS, faz a consulta ali mesmo, já faz hemograma, exame de urina, já faz até o eletrocardiograma e sai de lá com o diagnóstico e o remédio na mão", afirmou.

O encontro foi promovido pelo Conselho de Secretarias Municipais de Saúde de Minas Gerais (Cosems-MG) e reuniu outros candidatos ao governo para discutir propostas para a saúde entre 2027 e 2030.

Mateus também participou nesta quarta-feira de encontros na Fecomércio MG e no Conselho de Desenvolvimento Econômico, Sustentável e Estratégico de Belo Horizonte (Codese-BH).

articles.title: Fábrica de produtos de origem animal é interditada por irregularidades | G1
articles.standfirst: O local foi interditado pela Vigilância Sanitária nesta quarta-feira (16) em Birigui (SP).
articles.summary: Uma fábrica clandestina de produtos de origem animal foi interditada pela Vigilância Sanitária nesta quarta-feira (16) em Araçatuba (SP).
articles.body:
Uma fábrica clandestina de produtos de origem animal foi interditada pela Vigilância Sanitária nesta quarta-feira (16) em Birigui (SP).

Durante a inspeção, várias irregularidades foram encontradas na conservação e manipulação de hambúrgueres, espetinhos de carne e linguiças.

Uma fábrica clandestina de produtos de origem animal é interditada em Birigui (SP) — Foto: Divulgação

Segundo a vigilância, as condições de higiene poderiam comprometer a segurança dos alimentos e oferecer risco à saúde dos consumidores e de trabalhadores do local.

A fábrica não tinha licença para funcionamento. A TV TEM tentou contato com o proprietário da empresa, mas não obteve retorno até a última atualização desta reportagem.

A fiscalização foi realizada após uma denúncia anônima. Devido às péssimas condições, parte dos produtos armazenados de forma inadequada foi descartada pela equipe de fiscalização.

Os alimentos que ainda estavam próprios para consumo permaneceram no local, mas sem autorização para comercialização, distribuição ou utilização até que a empresa cumpra as regras sanitárias estabelecidas pela vigilância.

articles.summary: Confira as atividades de campanha de Dra. Lúcia Santos, Elizeu Aguiar, Geraldo Carvalho, Joel Rodrigues, Professor Gisvaldo, Rafael Fonteles e Santiago Belizário.
articles.body:
Candidatos ao Governo do Piauí nesta quarta (16) — Foto: Montagem/g1

Os candidatos ao Governo do Piauí cumpriram as atividades de campanha desta quarta-feira (16) em Teresina . As agendas incluíram participação caminhadas, panfletagens e encontros com lideranças e apoiadores.

O primeiro turno das eleições será realizado no dia 4 de outubro. Já o segundo turno, caso necessário, está marcado para 25 de outubro.

Veja abaixo como foi o dia de campanha de cada candidato, em ordem alfabética:

A candidata teve dois compromissos de campanha nesta quarta. Ela participou do debate durante a tarde e de uma reunião com os agentes de endemia da Fundação Municipal de Saúde de Teresina no início da noite.

O candidato também teve dois compromissos de campanha nesta quarta. Ele participou do debate durante a tarde e de um encontro com lideranças na Zona Sudeste de Teresina durante a noite.

O candidato não confirmou a agenda de campanha desta quarta.

Durante a tarde, o candidato participou do debate. Já à noite, ele esteve em um encontro promovido pela Escola de Fé e Política Dom Miguel Câmara, no Centro Pastoral Paulo VI, em Teresina. Ele destacou a necessidade de descentralizar ações e recursos do Estado para os municípios.

“Há uma necessidade da descentralização, de que o Estado se preocupe com as ações mais importantes, mais urgentes, educação, saúde, segurança, as obras estruturantes, o desenvolvimento do Estado. E aí as ações como o asfalto, calçamento, essas ações sejam descentralizadas para que os recursos cheguem na parceria com os gestores, para que eles entendam quais são as nossas prioridades. Isso vai fazer com que a gente enxugue a máquina pública, acabe os privilégios, porque as obras saem mais baratas e ainda com mais qualidade. A gente vai, de fato, contribuir para o desenvolvimento do nosso Estado", afirmou.

Em seguida, promoveu uma reunião com a população na quadra de uma escola particular no bairro Lourival Parente.

O candidato iniciou o dia com uma atividade de campanha no bairro São Joaquim, na Zona Norte de Teresina. Fez uma pausa e retomou a agenda no início da tarde, quando participou do debate.

Após o debate, realizou panfletagem na porta de um shopping no bairro Cabral e seguiu para a casa de uma apoiadora no Bairro Porenquanto. Encerrou a quarta com nova panfletagem na Praça Pedro II, no Centro.

Rafael concentrou a agenda no debate com outros candidatos ao Governo do Piauí.

O candidato visitou o Polo da Saúde, no Centro de Teresina, durante a manhã. Também fez caminhada no Mocambinho, na Zona Norte da capital, à noite.

articles.title: Lotofácil: prêmio de R$ 4,4 milhões atrai curiosos em cidade de MT | G1
articles.standfirst: Aposta simples levou prêmio milionário da Lotofácil da Independência em Ribeirão Cascalheira. Segundo dona da lotérica, é a primeira vez que um prêmio desse valor sai no município.
articles.summary: Aposta simples levou prêmio milionário da Lotofácil da Independência em Ribeirão Cascalheira. Segundo dona da lotérica, é a primeira vez que um prêmio desse valor sai no município.
articles.body:
Lotérica Trevo da Sorte, a única lotérica de Ribeirão Cascalheira (MT) — Foto: Reprodução

A única lotérica de Ribeirão Cascalheira , município de pouco mais de 10 mil habitantes no interior de Mato Grosso, virou ponto de curiosidade após uma aposta simples levar R$ 4.488.579 na Lotofácil da Independência , que teve o sorteio realizado nessa terça-feira (15).

Ao g1 , a dona da Lotérica Trevo da Sorte, Ivonete Nogueira Wanderleys, afirmou que desde que o resultado foi divulgado, moradores têm procurado o estabelecimento na tentativa de descobrir quem é o novo milionário da cidade.

“O que mais tem são curiosos querendo saber quem é o ganhador, quem é o sortudo”, contou.

Segundo Ivonete, essa é a primeira vez que um prêmio desse valor sai na lotérica. A proprietária disse que ficou feliz com a notícia e espera que o ganhador aproveite bem o dinheiro.

“Eu estou muito feliz por essa pessoa e espero que ela também esteja. Nunca tinha saído um prêmio igual a esse aqui. Deus abençoe essa pessoa para que ela possa saber usufruir do prêmio”, afirmou.

O jogo vencedor custou apenas R$ 3,50 e acertou sozinho os 15 números sorteados entre as apostas registradas em Ribeirão Cascalheira.

O município fica no interior de Mato Grosso e tem pouco mais de 10 mil habitantes. A cidade é conhecida pela localização no “coração do Brasil”, referência à posição geográfica no centro do país que aparece, inclusive, no hino municipal.

A aposta de Ribeirão Cascalheira foi uma das 72 de diferentes regiões do país que acertaram as 15 dezenas do concurso 3780 da Lotofácil da Independência. Cada uma recebeu R$ 4.488.579.

Mato Grosso teve ainda outro jogo entre os vencedores do prêmio principal. Em Cuiabá, um bolão também acertou as 15 dezenas e faturou R$ 4.488.579 . Nesse caso, porém, o prêmio será dividido. O bolão tem 50 cotas e foi feito com 18 números. Caso a divisão seja igual entre todas as cotas, cada uma ficará com cerca de R$ 89,7 mil.

Resultado da Lotofácil da Independência. — Foto: Reprodução/Caixa

O concurso 3780 da Lotofácil da Independência foi realizado nessa terça-feira (15). As dezenas sorteadas foram:

01 - 02 - 03 - 04 - 05 - 06 - 07 - 12 - 15 - 16 - 17 - 19 - 21 - 22 - 23.

O prêmio da faixa principal era estimado em R$ 300 milhões . Além das 72 apostas que acertaram os 15 números, 8.978 jogos fizeram 14 acertos e receberam R$ 2.762,74 cada.

Outras 290.866 apostas acertaram 13 números e ganharam R$ 17,50. Na faixa de 12 acertos, 3.465.636 jogos receberam R$ 7 cada, enquanto 19.323.208 apostas acertaram 11 dezenas e levaram R$ 3,50.

articles.title: Monotrilho de Poços de Caldas: trecho central será demolido até 2028 | G1
articles.standfirst: Medida faz parte de um TAC assinado com o Ministério Público e foi apresentada durante audiência pública que debateu nesta quarta-feira (16) o futuro do equipamento, desativado há 23 anos.
articles.summary: O monotrilho de Poços de Caldas terá seu trecho central removido até 2028 após acordo com o Ministério Público para preservar o patrimônio histórico local.
articles.body:
A Prefeitura de Poços de Caldas afirmou nesta quarta-feira (16) que o trecho central do monotrilho, entre o terminal de linhas urbanas e o museu , deverá ser demolido até 31 de dezembro de 2028. A medida integra um Termo de Ajustamento de Conduta (TAC) firmado com o Ministério Público. Já a situação do restante da estrutura, entre o museu e o atual Centro Administrativo, ainda está em discussão.

O assunto foi debatido durante audiência pública realizada pela Câmara Municipal de Poços de Caldas nesta quarta-feira (16). O encontro teve como tema “Cenário técnico, urbanístico, estrutural e as perspectivas futuras do Monotrilho de Poços de Caldas”.

A informação da demolição foi anunciada pelo Procurador Geral do Município Thiago Arantes e pelo Secretário Municipal de Planejamento Ercules Berlini Tassinari. Tassinari informou, inclusive, que a secretaria de planejamento já possui um diagnóstico para fazer a demolição e agora trabalha para publicar o processo de licitação para que o serviço seja efetivado.

Prefeitura anuncia demolição do trecho central do monotrilho de Poços de Caldas até o fim de 2028 — Foto: Júlia Reis/g1

Segundo as informações apresentadas, o trecho escolhido para a demolição passa por áreas que concentram bens tombados da cidade, entre eles o Palace Casino, o antigo prédio da prefeitura, a Urca e o museu.

Durante a audiência, seriam discutidos estudos e laudos relacionados à segurança da estrutura, as intervenções necessárias na via elevada localizada ao longo da Avenida João Pinheiro e adjacências, as tratativas jurídicas após a reversão da concessão para o patrimônio municipal e as alternativas financeiras e administrativas para o futuro do equipamento.

Também estariam em pauta diferentes possibilidades para a estrutura, incluindo a demolição controlada ou uma eventual revitalização integrada a um novo eixo de mobilidade ativa e lazer. A proposta do encontro foi reunir informações e contribuições para auxiliar na avaliação dos caminhos possíveis para o monotrilho.

Monotrilho de Poços de Caldas (MG) — Foto: Júlia Reis/g1

Quando o contrato para a construção do monotrilho em Poços de Caldas foi assinado, em 1982, a obra era apresentada como um projeto capaz de transformar a mobilidade urbana e impulsionar o turismo na cidade.

Os testes com passageiros começaram nos anos 2000. Após a inauguração oficial, o trem descarrilou em uma curva e 19 pessoas precisaram ser resgatadas pelo Corpo de Bombeiros.

O sistema funcionou poucas vezes e foi suspenso definitivamente em 2003, quando duas pilastras localizadas ao longo da Avenida João Pinheiro caíram e derrubaram cerca de 50 metros da estrutura.

Em 2019, a empresa responsável pelo projeto, J. Ferreira Ltda, abdicou do contrato de concessão do monotrilho e entregou a obra à Prefeitura de Poços de Caldas.

articles.title: Mulher que deu bolo envenenado para tentar matar marido é condenada | G1
articles.standfirst: Casal estava junto há 20 anos. Segundo MP, ela colocou 'chumbinho' na receita porque não aceitava fim do relacionamento.
articles.summary: Segundo MP, ela não aceitava fim do relacionamento.
articles.body:
Uma mulher que deu um bolo envenenado com "chumbinho" ao companheiro para tentar matá-lo foi condenada a 9 anos e 4 meses de prisão em regime inicial fechado, informou o Ministério Público de Santa Catarina (MPSC), que fez a denúncia contra ela. O caso ocorreu em Itajaí , no Litoral Norte do estado.

O casal estava junto há 20 anos e tinha união estável. Conforme o MP, a mulher cometeu o crime porque não aceitava o fim do relacionamento .

Na época, ela tinha 37 anos e o companheiro, 40. O g1 entrou em contato com a defesa da mulher e não havia obtido retorno até a última atualização desta reportagem.

A condenação ocorreu na sexta-feira (11), mas só foi divulgada pelo MPSC na terça (15). A mulher recebeu pena por tentativa de homicídio qualificada pelo emprego de veneno e motivo fútil .

Na dosimetria da pena, a Justiça considerou o uso do veneno como agravante e negou o direito de recorrer em liberdade.

Companheiro ficou mais de um mês sem trabalhar

Segundo a denúncia, o crime ocorreu no dia 15 de setembro de 2016, no bairro Cordeiros. A mulher preparou o bolo com "chumbinho", um agrotóxico usado ilegalmente como veneno para ratos.

Ela insistiu para que o companheiro comesse o doce. O homem ingeriu o alimento, sofreu uma intoxicação grave e passou mal no trabalho, onde foi socorrido por colegas e levado a um hospital.

Os laudos periciais constataram intoxicação e apontaram perigo de vida. Ele também precisou ficar sem trabalhar por mais de 30 dias .

Ainda conforme o MP, durante o processo o homem relatou que já tinha sido ameaçado pela companheira durante tentativas de terminar o relacionamento. Também afirmou que, dias antes do episódio, ela havia mencionado a intenção de comprar veneno para ratos.

A mulher negou a prática do crime e disse que não havia intenção de matar o companheiro, mas as provas técnicas e testemunhais do processo apontavam em outra direção.

articles.standfirst: Materiais bem escolhidos ajudam a integrar conforto, praticidade e convivência em um dos espaços mais valorizados da casa.
articles.summary: Materiais bem escolhidos ajudam a integrar conforto, praticidade e convivência em um dos espaços mais valorizados da casa.
articles.body:
Receber amigos e familiares em casa tem lugar de destaque na rotina de muitas famílias. Com isso, as áreas gourmet passaram por uma transformação nos últimos anos. O espaço que antes era dedicado apenas ao churrasco ganhou novas funções, integrando cozinha, piscina, varanda e áreas de convivência em um ambiente pensado para compartilhar momentos durante todo o ano, especialmente no verão.

Esse novo conceito também influenciou a escolha dos materiais. Pisos preparados para áreas externas, revestimentos que valorizam a arquitetura, metais resistentes e soluções voltadas para o uso diário ajudam a criar espaços que unem beleza, praticidade e durabilidade. O resultado é uma área gourmet capaz de atender diferentes ocasiões sem abrir mão do conforto.

A Ducha Externa Candalla DAX reúne ducha e lava-pés em uma única peça, oferecendo praticidade e resistência para áreas de lazer — Foto: Acervo Vilarejo

Entre os elementos que vêm ganhando espaço nesses projetos está a Ducha Externa Candalla DAX. Produzida em aço inox 316, material reconhecido pela alta resistência à umidade e à ação do tempo, ela foi desenvolvida para áreas externas e reúne ducha e lava-pés em um único equipamento. Além de facilitar a rotina antes e depois do uso da piscina, seu desenho minimalista se integra com facilidade a diferentes estilos de projeto.

O Acapulco Cinza Light EXT, da Villagres, oferece acabamento indicado para áreas externas e cria continuidade entre a piscina e o espaço gourmet — Foto: Acervo Vilarejo

No entorno da piscina, o Acapulco Cinza Light EXT 108x108, da Villagres, acompanha uma das principais tendências da arquitetura atual. Inspirado na aparência das pedras naturais, o porcelanato possui acabamento próprio para áreas externas, grande formato e uma tonalidade que favorece a integração com jardins, decks e mobiliário. A menor quantidade de juntas também contribui para um acabamento mais uniforme e facilita a manutenção do ambiente.

O Ombre Tile, da Roca Cerámica, cria um ponto de destaque na área gourmet com relevo, textura e movimento inspirados em elementos naturais — Foto: Acervo Vilarejo

As paredes também passaram a receber mais atenção nos projetos. Revestimentos decorativos ajudam a criar identidade para o espaço e valorizam churrasqueiras, bancadas e áreas de preparo. Um dos destaques é o Ombre Tile, da Roca Cerámica, que utiliza relevos e variações de textura para produzir um efeito visual marcante, tornando a parede um elemento de destaque sem comprometer a harmonia da composição.

Na Vilarejo, diferentes soluções podem ser combinadas para criar áreas gourmet preparadas para receber durante todas as estações. Revestimentos, porcelanatos, metais, louças, iluminação e acabamentos das principais marcas do mercado permitem desenvolver projetos que equilibram estética, funcionalidade e desempenho, com o suporte de uma equipe preparada para auxiliar na especificação dos materiais.

Mais do que acompanhar uma tendência, a área gourmet passou a refletir uma nova forma de viver a casa. Um espaço pensado para reunir pessoas, aproveitar os dias ao ar livre e transformar encontros simples em momentos especiais.

articles.title: Analista explica limitação que deu origem ao 'Pilili' da urna | G1
articles.standfirst: Origem do aviso que se tornou símbolo sonoro da eleição surge da necessidade básica de um sistema eleitoral que migrava das cédulas de papel para votação digital.
articles.summary: Origem do aviso que se tornou símbolo sonoro da eleição surge da necessidade básica de um sistema eleitoral que migrava das cédulas de papel para votação digital.
articles.body:
O barulho que se tornou o símbolo sonoro do processo eleitoral brasileiro e deu até nome para a mascote das eleições surgiu simplesmente de uma limitação tecnológica. O barulho da urna, aquele "pilili" que avisa quando o eleitor terminou de votar soa como uma sequência de 'beeps' porque é exatamente isso: uma sequência do único som que aquele tipo de computador era capaz de produzir há 30 anos.

“Naquela época, em 1996, os recursos computacionais eram restritos. Não existiam dispositivos de multimídia. O máximo que o computador fazia era dar um ‘beep’. O que tentamos fazer dentro do que era possível era um ‘beep’ diferenciado, para que o mesário conseguisse saber que o eleitor terminou o voto com sucesso”, explica Giuseppe Janino, de Canoas, ex-secretário de tecnologia da informação do TSE e um dos autores do projeto da urna eletrônica brasileira.

O aviso que acabou por se tornar o símbolo da urna eletrônica surgiu justamnte durante a transformação do sistema eleitoral , que migrava das cédulas de papel para uma votação digital .

“Essa sequência de ‘piripipi’ foi o que se tinha na época justamente para que o mesário tivesse a noção do tempo de votação do eleitor. E esse som acabou se inserindo na cultura do brasileiro e representa, está muito ligado à nossa urna eletrônica brasileira”, completa Janino, que tem formação em Matemática e Análise de Sistemas.

O aviso sonoro está tão inserido na cultura eleitoral do país que, em maio, o TSE apresentou ao público a mascote Pilili, fruto de um projeto que integra as ações de comunicação dos 30 anos da urna eletrônica. O objetivo, segundo a Corte Eleitoral, é “levar para uma linguagem mais próxima das novas gerações um equipamento que já faz parte da história das eleições brasileiras”.

“Tem mesário que passa a noite em claro ouvindo esse ‘piripipi’ a noite toda depois de um dia de trabalho”, brinca Janino. “Mas ele é realmente uma característica importante que representa culturalmente a nossa urna eletrônica”.

articles.title: Love is in the Eyre: China turns to classic English novel to teach teens about romance
articles.summary: When teenagers went back to school in China earlier this month, one book on their new mandatory reading list stood out: the 19th century English novel “Jane Eyre.”
articles.body: When teenagers went back to school in China earlier this month, one book on their new mandatory reading list stood out: the 19th century English novel “Jane Eyre.” The literary classic, originally considered a trailblazing tale of female empowerment, might seem a surprising choice in a country where textbooks are tightly curated by the state to ensure ideological conformity. But Beijing sees another message in Charlotte Brontë’s work –– the value of finding true love. The story presents a counterbalance to the “superficial notions about appearance and wealth” of the social media age, according to the state-run Beijing Daily newspaper. In recent years, online novels and micro dramas featuring outlandish plots of wealth flaunting, wronged lovers, brooding billionaires and ill-fated mistresses plotting revenge have become mainstream entertainment. And that’s attracted the attention of China’s censors. In June, the broadcasting regulator launched a campaign to crack down on “harmful and lowbrow” content seen as promoting “distorted” views on relationships and marriage. But reading the story of Jane Eyre –– an orphan girl who finds her independence while suffering a series of hardships and eventually falls in love with her wealthy employer –– will help China’s 14-year-olds “develop sounder values,” said Beijing Daily. “When children are first beginning to experience romantic feelings and are still naive and inexperienced, it is a crucial stage for developing a healthy character,” it said. The coming-of-age story has been wildly popular in China since it first arrived in the country in 1925 and has been translated, published and adapted into theatre and screen productions countless times. A British film even made its way to Chinese theatres in 1979, following the country’s turbulent Cultural Revolution. Jane Eyre –– who famously says to her future husband “do you think, because I am poor, obscure, plain and little, I am soulless and heartless? You think wrong” –– has long been seen as an anti-repression heroine by the working class in China. And the book has long been accepted by China’s ruling communist party. But its inclusion in the curriculum is striking at a time when other forms of feminist discussion and activism have increasingly come under scrutiny in China. And some parents have questioned whether modern day Chinese youths who have been raised in a relatively comfortable environment, could understand or relate to the deep and complicated love story portrayed in the novel. One parent said that her son had asked whether reading Jane Eyre was “teaching girls in (his) class that their brain should being wrongly ruled by love.” The parent, writing on social media platform Xiaohongshu, said that her son couldn’t understand why Jane chooses to marry a man who was blind, and the whole thing looked like a bad deal. Qin Shiwen, a recent Chinese literature graduate in Beijing told CNN that including a classic like Jane Eyre into primary education “is very necessary.” “China’s basic education system places a heavy emphasis on academic knowledge and high achievement, but very, very little focus on love or character development,” said Shiwen. But the book, first published in 1847, has in recent years been criticized for its treatment of a character Brontë often describes as a ‘mad woman.” “The more I think about it, the more problematic I find it,” said Yan Hairong, a sociology scholar at Beijing’s Tsinghua University, pointing to the portrayal of the “mad woman in the attic” and the book’s “underlying themes of colonialism.” Yan has doubts whether the novel will help Chinese teenagers build up healthy values, saying some students may just absorb it “without critically examining the problematic ideas embedded within it.” “I have some concerns about teaching the novel at the middle-school level, particularly if it is presented as a textbook or as an example of profound romantic love,” Yan told CNN. Ideological drive China’s new school textbooks, launched this month, have gone through extensive revision as part of an ongoing effort to align children’s thoughts and values with the core values promoted by the ruling communist party. The party history, Chinese morality and the country’s legal system have become essential components of the 9-year mandatory education system in recent years. And in 2021, officials published a new series of texts to explain leader Xi Jinping’s thoughts on socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era. Besides Jane Eyre, other changes this year include the removal of an article on creative thinking and the inclusion of a new texts teaching children how to be a well-rounded socialist builders and stories about China’s athletic and space achievements.

articles.title: Congress passes sweeping US sanctions bill targeting Russia
articles.summary: The bill marks the first time in more than two years the US Congress has passed legislation supporting Ukraine
articles.body:
The United States House of Representatives has passed a bipartisan sanctions bill targeting Russia over its continued war in Ukraine.

Lawmakers on Wednesday voted to send the sweeping legislation, championed by the late Republican Senator Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, to US President Donald Trump’s desk, ending more than a year of delays and obstacles. The final vote was 262 to 159. It had already passed in the US Senate.

The much-anticipated bill would give the president new abilities to impose tariffs of up to 100 percent on countries, like China and India, that import energy supplies from Russia, allowing Washington to further restrict funds sent to Moscow. The measure would also impose sanctions on Russian officials, banks and a shadow fleet of tankers that keeps Russian energy moving.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has been pushing for the bill’s passage and made a direct appeal to senators shortly before they passed it last month.

Fifty-eight Democrats bucked their party’s leadership and joined with a majority of Republicans to pass it.

The Democratic Party has overwhelmingly supported Ukraine in the war. However, House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries opposed the bill, citing new tariff authorities given to the White House that could be used to exploit US allies.

“The manner in which this bill has been written doesn’t require the president of the United States to impose sanctions on Russia,” Jeffries said on the House floor Wednesday. “In fact, there are so many loopholes written into the bill, I believe, that it’s very unlikely that the sanctions relief contemplated in the legislation will ever see the light of day.”

The bill marks the first time in more than two years the US Congress has passed legislation supporting Ukraine. Graham, after whom the bill was named following his sudden death in July, had helped negotiate Trump’s support for it.

House Speaker Mike Johnson heralded the bill’s passage, saying it places “maximum pressure on … the Russian war machine”, including the country’s President Vladimir Putin.

“For too long, Putin has bankrolled this devastating war with money and resources from countries willing to look the other way, and today, that ends,” Johnson said in a post on social media. “This bill sends a powerful message of American unity and gives the Administration every tool in the toolbox to help bring this war to a just end, and we are proud to send it to the President’s desk.”

After the vote, a group of Republicans and Democrats from the House and Senate celebrated the vote at a rare bipartisan news conference.

Democratic Senator Richard Blumenthal of Connecticut, who wrote the bill with Graham, said he hopes the sanctions will help force Putin to the negotiating table and end the war.

“To Vladimir Putin – we have your number,” Blumenthal said. “And to Ukraine – you are not alone.”

Trump is expected to sign the bill into law.

articles.title: Maryland family speaks out after ‘4-foot-long’ rabid beaver attacks 13-year-old boy
articles.summary: Family said a beaver attacked without provocation at Cunningham Falls State Park in Frederick County before testing positive for rabies.
articles.body: The family of a 13-year-old boy who was viciously attacked by a rabid beaver in Maryland has spoken out about the incident, describing the animal as a massive, four-foot-long adult. The July 26 incident was the first of three rabid beaver attacks that prompted Cunningham Falls State Park in Frederick County to close, according to the family's GoFundMe. The teen was identified as Dominick Cebula by WUSA 9. Dominick was swimming and looking at fish underwater in a designated area when the beaver suddenly struck his chest and latched onto him, the family said in their online fundraiser. RABID BAT FOUND NEAR ZOO RESTAURANT SPARKS URGENT PUBLIC HEALTH WARNING: 'EXTREMELY SERIOUS' The family said the unprovoked attack unfolded in front of the boy's mother and younger brother, who watched in horror from the shore. "This 4-foot-long beaver (not a cute little cuddly beaver — this thing was as big as his 8-year-old brother) came out of nowhere from the deep of the lake, beelined straight toward D, and began biting and attacking him," Dominick's aunt, Leigh Cebula, said. "He did not provoke it, poke it, or mess with it in any way. This was completely unprovoked." Dad Jeff Cebula told WUSA 9 the beaver began shaking its head and refused to let go. "He grabbed its head and a leg, and he tried to get it off of him," Jeff said. "At that point, he kind of felt that it was locked onto him. And then it started shaking its head, kind of like a dog would do." Dominick eventually managed to pull the beaver off his chest and tried to back away with his hands raised, his dad said. The beaver then lunged at him again and bit his right hand, prompting Dominick to fight it off a second time. He was promptly airlifted to Johns Hopkins Hospital, where doctors began treating his wounds and administering rabies post-exposure treatment. "It was so traumatic. He was lifeflighted to Johns Hopkins because the paramedics were worried his lung was punctured. Luckily it wasn't," Dominick's mother, Alishia Cebula, told Fox News Digital. The boy is now recovering well after undergoing surgery earlier this month. NORTH CAROLINA WARNS MOBILE PETTING ZOO VISITORS OF RABIES EXPOSURE AFTER BABY GOATS TEST POSITIVE "He is doing much better. He just had surgery on 9/4 to repair a severed nerve in his finger," Alishia said. "He had a lot of appointments, especially with the rabies vaccines he had to get. Thank God for the vaccine. "Luckily, we're getting to the end of this traumatic event." Leigh added that the incident happened in an area where the family had swum for years and had never spotted beavers before. After the attack, the beaver was euthanized after testing positive for rabies. Swimming access to Hunting Creek Lake at the park was closed soon afterward. The incident marked the first in a series of three attacks at the park. On Aug. 5, a 19-year-old fisherman was bitten in the ankle by a beaver. articles.title: Pentagon CTO Emil Michael does not want US government to do with AI companies what it has done with Intel and Nippon Steel
articles.summary: Tech News News: The Pentagon's chief technology officer (CTO) has said that he does not want the Trump administration to acquire equity or seek partial state ownershi.
articles.body: The Pentagon's chief technology officer (CTO) has said that he does not want the Trump administration to acquire equity or seek partial state ownership in artificial intelligence (AI) companies, even as the government has already bought into firms like Intel and Nippon Steel-owned US Steel. Speaking to CNBC, Emil Michael was asked whether Washington might eventually take partial ownership stakes in AI companies — a possibility that has gained traction as worries mount over how quickly the technology is advancing. His response was blunt: “I hope not.”“We don’t want [the] government to get in the middle. That doesn’t really go well in terms of nationalisation,” he said, noting that the US AI leaders are among the “biggest companies in the history of the world.” The current administration has already built up a portfolio of stakes in private firms, and the list includes a 10% holding in Intel and a “golden share” arrangement in US Steel, which now operates under Nippon Steel.Emil Michael’s pushback on tighter regulationMichael also made clear he isn't in favour of tightening regulatory control over AI companies, a stance that puts him at odds with some industry voices. For example, Anthropic's CEO Dario Amodei has previously urged the sector to slow down the pace of releasing increasingly powerful models in order to reduce potential risks.Explaining his position, Michael described a divide between those who favour pre-emptive regulation similar to Europe's approach and those who believe companies should instead be held accountable for building products that are safe and properly aligned before they ever reach the public.He did say that the recent security breach involving AI platform Hugging Face was troubling but he wasn't sure what form of regulation could have prevented such an incident.Even while rejecting calls for heavier regulation, Michael cautioned that it would be risky to hand over complete trust to a small group of AI company chiefs. He said his focus instead is on making sure existing rules are properly enforced, noting that the Federal Trade Commission already has “a ton of laws on the book” that apply.The Trump administration has been a vocal backer of rapid AI expansion and data centre growth, viewing it as key to maintaining an edge over China. articles.title: Robert Kraft says Ed Sheeran asked him to donate $2m to aid after Macklemore backlash
articles.summary: It comes after Macklemore pledged $1m to Palestinian causes, challenging the tycoon to match the sum.
articles.body:
Robert Kraft, the US stadium owner who had pro-Palestinian rapper Macklemore removed as Ed Sheeran's opening act, says Sheeran asked him to match his own $2m (£1.5m) donation for "aid in the region".

It came after Macklemore said he would donate $1m (£750,000) to Palestinian organisations, challenging Kraft to match him.

Kraft, who owns the New England Patriots, wrote on Wednesday: "Earlier today, before Macklemore challenged me to match his donation, Ed called me and asked me to commit $2 million to match his donation to aid in the region to fight this humanitarian crisis.

"Ed now plans to reach out to other venue owners and our goal is to continue to work together to build bridges."

Kraft did not confirm whether he has agreed to make the $2m donation and where the funds would go, and this is the first time it has been suggested Sheeran had donated that sum.

The musician has not commented about any donation he is making or other philanthropic plans.

Kraft's comments came in his second statement this week on the controversy over Sheeran's US tour.

On Monday, he confirmed he had Macklemore dropped as the opening act for the British singer's forthcoming performance at his Gillette Stadium near Boston, accusing the rapper of hate speech during a previous show for calling for "Free Palestine" and making other comments and showing images of Gaza on stage.

Macklemore's removal sparked a backlash, with Sheeran's other support acts dropping out in protest.

Sheeran has said the decision to drop Macklemore from his Loop Tour was made by promoters and that he would not be drawn into a public debate over Gaza.

In the statement, which was issued by Gillette Stadium on Kraft's behalf, he said he would like those speaking in support of the Palestinian people to know that he has long "supported efforts that create opportunity for Palestinians".

He also said that he has worked to bring "young Palestinians and Israelis together to build businesses, create jobs, and forge relationships".

"I have dedicated much of my life to building bridges between all people," Kraft said. "I believe deeply that all lives are worth protecting."

The owner of the Kraft Group, a sports and event management company, did not say whether he had rallied other stadium owners to ban Macklemore from their venues, as the rapper claims.

Macklemore - real name Benjamin Haggerty - called for a "free Palestine" and showed images of devastation in Gaza during two Sheeran concerts in New Jersey earlier this month.

He was dropped on Monday from Sheeran's line-up, just days before the tour was set to resume in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, on Saturday.

Sheeran, who performed at Kraft's 2022 wedding, said on Tuesday he was not responsible for Macklemore being removed as an opening act from the tour.

How being music's Mr Nice Guy contributed to biggest crisis of Ed Sheeran's career

Kraft, who is Jewish, confirmed on Monday that he had made the decision to bar Macklemore from the Gillette Stadium because his venue would not "provide a platform for hate speech".

The tycoon accused the Grammy-winning rapper of having "a broader history of antisemitic rhetoric", which Macklemore denies.

He also said the pro-Palestinian artist was "only sharing selective information and ignoring the actions of Hamas".

All the other support acts from Sheeran's US tour have since quit in solidarity with Macklemore.

They are Finneas, the brother of pop star Billie Eilish, Irish singer-songwriter Aaron Rowe and Danish band Lukas Graham, as well as Irish folk band Beoga, who perform with Sheeran on stage every night.

The artists argued that Macklemore's removal represented a chilling effect on free speech.

Macklemore said on Wednesday he would donate the entire $1m of his net earnings from Sheeran's Loop Tour to six Palestinian organisations "to bring the conversation back to where it belongs: to the Palestinian people".

"This is a manmade injustice, and I believe it requires immediate political change," he wrote on social media.

articles.title: Morocco’s 2026 election: A test of political trust and engagement
articles.summary: Youth unemployment, living costs and public services are key issues before the September 23 vote.
articles.body:
Rabat, Morocco – Morocco’s parliamentary election campaign began on September 10, with 27 political parties competing for 395 seats in the House of Representatives. More than 15.8 million voters are registered for the September 23 vote, which will determine Parliament’s composition and play a central role in forming the next government.

But beyond the competition between parties, the election raises a deeper question: whether citizens believe the political system can respond to the problems shaping their daily lives.

That question is particularly important for younger Moroccans. An Afrobarometer survey published in March found that roughly a third of Moroccans aged 18 to 35 expressed trust in Parliament, the head of government and political parties. At the same time, young people were more likely than older Moroccans to post political content on social media and participate in demonstrations.

That does not necessarily mean young Moroccans are disengaged. The more important issue is whether they see electoral politics as an effective way of addressing the problems they face.

Morocco’s electoral politics operate within the constitutional framework established in 2011. The constitution defines Morocco as a constitutional, democratic, parliamentary and social monarchy and establishes a separation and balance of powers while preserving the monarchy’s central institutional role.

Under Article 47, the king appoints the head of government from the political party that comes first in elections to the House of Representatives. The king also presides over the Council of Ministers, while the government exercises executive power and Parliament exercises legislative and oversight functions.

Winning the largest number of seats, therefore, matters for forming the government, but the parliamentary result does not by itself determine the full distribution of political power.

A younger electorate, an older political system

The age profile of the electorate makes the question of political engagement more consequential.

Official figures show that voters aged 18 to 24 account for 4 percent of those registered, while people aged 60 and above account for 29 percent. But those figures describe the electoral roll, not turnout, but they show how heavily the registered electorate is weighted towards older citizens.

Morocco also faces a substantial youth employment problem. The IMF estimates that unemployment stood at 13 percent in 2025, while unemployment among 15-to-24-year-olds reached 37.3 percent. It estimates that 25.2 percent of young people were not in employment, education or training in the third quarter of 2025. The IMF also points to skills mismatches, limited private-sector dynamism and pronounced gender disparities in labour-market participation.

For young people struggling to enter the labour market, promises about growth, jobs and purchasing power are not abstract campaign issues. They are measures of whether the political system can deliver opportunities visible in everyday life.

When economic frustration becomes political

Those pressures have also surfaced outside formal electoral politics.

In late July, roughly 60,000 people entered the autonomous Spanish city of Ceuta from Morocco in the largest such surge in recent history, according to the news agency Reuters. The report linked the crossings to economic hardship, social unrest and misinformation circulating on social media, alongside migration aspirations and false expectations about Spanish court rulings.

While this episode may not have been a direct measure of electoral opinion or evidence of a single political cause, it illustrated how economic expectations, migration aspirations and perceptions of opportunity can intersect.

That provides a wider context for the election’s economic debate: whether Morocco’s recent growth and major development projects are producing opportunities that younger citizens can see in their own lives.

The economy has been growing strongly. The IMF estimates that real GDP grew by 4.9 percent in 2025 and projects growth of 4.4 percent in 2026. Yet high unemployment, particularly among young people, has remained a significant challenge.

Strong growth has not translated into sufficient job creation.

Employment and purchasing power feature prominently in the programmes of the three parties that have formed the governing coalition since 2021: the National Rally of Independents (RNI), the Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM) and Istiqlal.

The RNI’s 2026–2031 programme promises one million jobs and a gradual increase in the minimum wage to 5,000 dirhams (about $530) per month. PAM has pledged at least one million jobs and put the cost of its five-year programme at 350 billion dirhams ($37.1bn). Istiqlal has placed purchasing power and public services at the centre of its campaign, alongside proposals on healthcare, housing, employment, water management and food security.

The programmes differ in emphasis, but their common focus is revealing: Employment, household purchasing power and public services have become central measures of political credibility.

The challenge for the next government will be turning investment and growth into more productive jobs and higher living standards.

The Justice and Development Party (PJD), led by former head of government Abdelilah Benkirane, enters the election seeking to rebuild support after its dramatic losses in 2021.

The party fell from 125 seats in the previous parliament to 13. In the September 2021 election, the RNI won 102 seats, followed by PAM with 87 and Istiqlal with 81. The three parties subsequently formed the governing coalition.

The PJD has presented a programme built around five axes and 467 measures covering institutional, economic, social and foreign policy. The programme emphasises concrete reforms and measures rather than extensive numerical targets, covering areas including public services, employment, purchasing power and institutional reform.

Its return adds another dimension to the contest as the governing parties defend their record since 2021 and the PJD attempts to rebuild its electoral base.

The election will test whether Morocco’s political system can maintain a credible connection between an ambitious development agenda and the expectations of citizens who want to see its benefits in everyday life.

For younger Moroccans, the relatively low trust in political institutions alongside very high youth unemployment points to traditional electoral politics facing competition from other forms of political expression at a time when employment and living standards are increasingly important.

At a time when employment and economic standards are central to political party platforms, economic researcher Nouh El Harmouzi argues that the challenge extends beyond what parties can promise during an election campaign.

“Morocco’s economic problems are fundamentally structural and cannot be resolved through short-term electoral promises.”

articles.title: Yemeni forces target Houthis as US rules out direct role
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia requests missile defence support from allies as the US sees its own stock of interceptors dwindle.
articles.body:
The United States reiterated its support for Yemen’s internationally recognised government on Wednesday as fighting intensified between the Saudi-led coalition and Houthi forces. US officials also held direct talks with Houthi representatives in Oman last weekend, according to sources cited by Reuters.

Yemeni government forces said that the coalition had struck Houthi positions around Mocha and that government forces had launched drone attacks in Marib. The Houthis claimed to have shot down a Saudi F-15 fighter jet over Marib.

Saudi Arabia is running low on missile interceptors and has asked regional and Western allies for help, according to two officials who spoke to The Associated Press news agency. The Saudis asked France, Pakistan, Egypt and the United Kingdom to deploy air-defence support to help defend against attacks by the Houthis. One official said Saudi Arabia’s main ally and arms supplier, the US, has seen its own stock of interceptors dwindle over the course of the war with Iran.

US Central Command (CENTCOM) spokesman Tim Hawkins told Al Jazeera that the US is “closely monitoring” the situation between Houthis and the Saudi-backed government in Yemen, adding that the US military has a longstanding “military relationship with our Saudi partners, and you see that manifesting today”.

Even as Washington assists the Saudi campaign, American officials held direct talks with Houthi representatives in Oman last weekend, according to three sources who spoke to the Reuters news agency on condition of anonymity. The meeting took place at the US embassy in Muscat with the assistance of the Omani government, two of the sources said.

At the Muscat meeting, the Houthis told US officials they had no intention of attacking US vessels and were committed to the 2025 ceasefire with the US, according to the sources cited by Reuters.

Meanwhile, the top US diplomat for Yemen, Neil Hop, told Yemen’s Foreign Minister Afrah al-Zouba that the US maintained its “strong support” for Yemen’s internationally recognised government, according to the US embassy in Yemen.

“The United States of America stands in solidarity with the Yemen government and its people against Iran-backed Houthi aggression,” the embassy said, citing Hop in a post on X.

The Yemeni government’s army said the Saudi-led coalition targeted Houthi outposts and equipment around the southwestern port city of Mocha. In a separate social media post, the government’s army also said they conducted drone attacks on Houthi forces in northern Marib governorate .

On Wednesday evening, Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said that “Saudi warplanes launched 40 air strikes targeting the provinces of Taiz, Marib and Hodeidah over the past 24 hours”. In response, the Houthis targeted the Khamis Mushait airbase and an oil facility in the Saudi Red Sea port city of Yanbu, the group said in a statement.

The Houthis also claimed to have shot down a Saudi fighter jet using a “locally made surface-to-air missile” over the central province of Marib. Al Jazeera’s Yemen correspondent Yousef Mawry said the downing of Saudi fighter jets “could very well mean a change in the balance of power” as “Saudi Arabia depends heavily on its ability to carry out air strikes against Houthi positions in various provinces”.

articles.title: US extends visa ban on Palestinian officials before UN General Assembly
articles.summary: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas is among those barred for the second year in a row.
articles.body:
The United States Department of State has announced it will extend visa sanctions on officials of the Palestinian Authority (PA) and members of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), preventing Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas from travelling to New York ahead of his address to the United Nations General Assembly next week for the second year in a row.

“As a consequence of their failure to reform, contrary to their commitments to the United States, and their ongoing activities that undermine the prospects for peace, the United States will extend sanctions that deny visas to PLO members and PA officials,” the State Department said in a statement.

The State Department accused the PA of violating US law by pursuing international recognition of Palestinian statehood outside direct negotiations, taking its dispute with Israel to international courts and providing payments to people the US and Israel label as convicted attackers and their families.

It added that the PA mission to the UN would keep a waiver under the UN Headquarters Agreement, which allows its regular staff to continue working even as individual officials are barred from entering the US.

Abbas’s speech this year had been expected to press for international recognition of Palestinian statehood and renewed momentum behind a two-state solution, following a wave of recognitions this month by the United Kingdom, France, Canada and other Western governments, as well as to draw attention to the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza and the rapid expansion of illegal Israeli settlements and settler pogroms across the occupied West Bank.

No Israeli officials face equivalent US travel restrictions, despite an International Criminal Court arrest warrant issued against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over alleged war crimes in Gaza.

Last year’s ban drew criticism from Palestinian officials and UN human rights experts, who said the visa bans breach the US’s obligation to allow individuals invited by the UN to travel to its New York headquarters, and have argued that singling out Palestinian representatives while shielding Israeli leaders undermines Washington’s stated commitment to a negotiated peace.

articles.title: In 1955, Christopher Cockerell used a cat-food tin, coffee can and reversed vacuum cleaner; the experiment helped create the hovercraft
articles.summary: UK News: In 1955, British engineer Christopher Cockerell was testing an idea that would transform amphibious transport, using equipment that looked more suited.
articles.body: In 1955, British engineer Christopher Cockerell was testing an idea that would transform amphibious transport, using equipment that looked more suited to a kitchen than an engineering workshop. His early experiment involved two tin cans, a vacuum-cleaner fan and, an empty cat-food tin placed inside a coffee tin. Cockerell was trying to prove that a cushion of air could lift a vessel clear of the water and reduce drag. The experiment helped demonstrate the principle behind the hovercraft, leading to his first patent and, eventually, the development of the SR.N1, the first man-carrying amphibious hovercraft.How Cockerell developed the hovercraft ideaCockerell's interest in the idea developed after he left Marconi and bought a small boat and caravan hire business, later named Ripplecraft. He began considering how vessels could move faster and realised that a craft lifted clear of the water would no longer experience the same drag. As per the American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials, he theorised that air could be channelled around the vessel to create what he called a “momentum curtain”, allowing an amphibious craft to be lifted completely out of the water.The Made up in Britain account similarly explains that Cockerell's design sought to make a vehicle move over both land and water while floating on a layer of air. His experiments eventually led him to use a modified punt equipped with a pump that forced high-pressure air beneath and around its rim. A strong rubber curtain helped retain much of the air, producing the lift needed to support the craft.Cockerell files his first hovercraft patentThe significance of the small-scale experiment was that it gave Cockerell evidence that his air-cushion theory could work in practice. Rather than relying on conventional contact between a vessel and water, the concept used air to create a cushion beneath the craft. Transportation History states that Cockerell's experiments resulted in a workable version by 1955, when he “filed his first patent for it.”According to Made up in Britain, Cockerell established Ripplecraft to develop the concept and eventually persuaded the Ministry of Supply to support the project in 1955. The military establishment was initially difficult to convince, with Cockerell recalling: “The Admiralty said it was a plane and not a boat, the Royal Air Force said it was a boat and not a plane, the Army were plain not interested.” His invention nevertheless continued towards full-scale development.The SR.N1 becomes the first man-carrying hovercraftCockerell's patent and continued development eventually attracted government-backed support. In 1958 the National Research Development Corporation ordered Saunders-Roe Limited to construct a full-scale hovercraft prototype. The resulting vehicle, the SR.N1, could carry up to four people at a speed of 28 miles per hour (45.1 kilometres per hour). It was formally introduced to the public on 11 June 1959.The SR.N1 as the world's first man-carrying amphibious hovercraft and says Saunders Roe developed the 20-foot craft under Cockerell's guidance. The project demonstrated that the principle first tested with a pair of tins and a vacuum-cleaner fan could be developed into a full-sized vehicle capable of travelling across different surfaces.Cockerell's simple experiment becomes a transport breakthroughAfter being shipped to France in July 1959, it successfully crossed the English Channel between Calais and Dover. The same year the NRDC established a subsidiary called Hovercraft Development and appointed Cockerell as its technical director.What began with an improvised arrangement of tins and a vacuum-cleaner fan had therefore progressed into a man-carrying amphibious craft and a new means of transportation. Cockerell continued improving the hovercraft and exploring other applications of the air-cushion principle.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: British university reinstates Egyptian student who was suspended after pro-Palestinian protests
articles.summary: A prestigious London university will re-enrol an Egyptian student who was suspended following his participation in pro-Palestinian protests.
articles.body: A prestigious London university will re-enrol an Egyptian student who was suspended following his participation in pro-Palestinian protests, after senior leadership initially enforced disciplinary action that could have triggered his deportation from the UK. Usama Ghanem, 22, will return to King’s College London (KCL) this fall, nearly 18 months after university officials indefinitely suspended him and moved to revoke his visa sponsorship, according to an email he received in late August. This followed three reviews over his alleged actions in student-led demonstrations calling for the liberation of Palestinian people from Israel’s bombing and siege in Gaza. While the university said in the email it upheld its allegations of non-academic misconduct against Ghanem in relation to those actions, dating to 2024 and 2025, it has now informed him that there were “no breaches” of the terms of his exclusion. “The conditions set have been met and there is no reason for your suspension or exclusion to remain in place,” the email said. “Accordingly, you will be invited to re-enrol for the 2026/27 academic year and will be permitted access to King’s College London.” The university also confirmed to Ghanem that it would start the process of reviving his visa sponsorship, in a separate memo sent on September 1. Ghanem’s case, which CNN covered in February, prompted public outcry from some academics, who warned against what they described as a crackdown by US and UK universities that they said disproportionately targeted Muslim students and students of color for lawful expressions of Palestinian solidarity and legitimate criticism of Israel. Ghanem told CNN he “unequivocally” denied the allegations of misconduct. He said the outcome of his review had set “a huge precedent,” adding that he would still press for “Palestinian rights, and the fight for divestment from all of weapons and from all complicit actors with the genocide in Gaza.” In June, an independent United Nations commission found that Israel was continuing to commit genocide against Palestinians by deliberately targeting children in Gaza. The Israeli government has repeatedly denied committing genocide and dismissed the UN findings. In a statement to CNN, a spokesperson for KCL said, “A review of Mr Ghanem’s suspension was always scheduled to take place one year after it was put in place, as it is standard process for non-academic misconduct cases to set a specific review date.” “Following that review, a panel determined that he had met the conditions agreed for suspension, and that re-enrolment was now the appropriate outcome,” the statement added. “The reasons for Mr Ghanem’s original suspension were upheld by the panel and clearly communicated with him. We will always apply a fair approach to misconduct proceedings, and have a duty to act where behaviour breaches safeguarding and security regulations, or puts others at risk.” Asked by CNN about KCL’s decision to start the process of reviving Ghanem’s visa sponsorship, the spokesperson said, “Decisions about visa sponsorship are not made by King’s but by UK Visas & Immigration, who we have a legal duty to notify of any change in student status.” The Home Office, under which UK Visas & Immigration falls, has not yet responded to CNN’s request for comment. Although Ghanem will be returning to KCL, a legal case he filed against the university is ongoing. It claims breaches of human rights, assault, personal injury, discrimination and harassment on the part of KCL. In a statement provided to CNN in January, a university spokesperson told CNN that students at KCL “are not disciplined for lawful affiliations, including support for pro-Palestine views, nor for participating in lawful protests,” adding: “It is incorrect to suggest students with different perspectives are treated differently.” The allegations of non-academic misconduct upheld by KCL involve “regulatory” and “procedural breaches,” “health and safety concerns,” “offensive or abusive behaviour” and “operational obstruction,” according to a letter sent by senior leadership. Ghanem does not have lawful immigration status in a third country. After KCL initially moved to revoke his visa sponsorship, he said he feared for his safety if he returned to Egypt. He has remained in Britain since KCL initially moved to revoke his visa sponsorship last May. Reflecting on the outcome of the review, Ghanem’s UK lawyer, Franck Magennis, praised “sustained legal and public efforts” by supporters.

articles.title: Man accused of cultivating opium poppy gets relief as J&K HC refuses to cancel bail
articles.summary: News News: NEW DELHI: The Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh high court has refused to interfere with bail granted to a man accused of cultivating opium poppy on one.
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh high court has refused to interfere with bail granted to a man accused of cultivating opium poppy on one marla of land, noting that he had not violated any of the conditions imposed while on bail. The court dismissed the Union Territory’s plea challenging the bail order on September 1, 2026.Why was the man arrested?According to the court order, Ghulam Nabi Mir was arrested on May 6, 2026, on allegations that he had cultivated an opium poppy crop on one marla of land. The Special Judge, NDPS, Anantnag, initially granted him interim bail on May 29, which was subsequently made absolute.The Union Territory challenged the bail, arguing that Mir had committed an offence punishable under Section 18(c) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act. It also questioned the Special Judge’s reasoning while granting bail.What did the high court find?Justice Rajnesh Oswal noted that there was no allegation that Mir had breached any of the bail conditions after his release.“The petitioner was arrested on 06.05.2026 and was enlarged on interim bail vide order dated 29.05.2026. There is, however, no whisper that the respondent, after being granted bail, had violated the terms and conditions imposed by the court of learned Special Judge, NDPS, Anantnag, in terms of order dated 29.05.2026,” the court said.The bench also considered the applicability of Section 37 of the NDPS Act. The court said the restrictions under that provision did not apply in the present case and that the bail application was therefore required to be considered under Section 18(c) of the Act.“Admittedly, the rigours of Section 37 of NDPS were not applicable in the instant case and the bail application ought to have been considered solely taking into consideration the provisions of Section 18(c) of the NDPS Act,” the court noted.The court also noted that the Special Judge had referred to the Supreme Court’s direction in Anna Waman Bahalerao versus State of Maharashtra regarding disposal of bail applications within two months. The Special Judge had also recorded that there was nothing on record suggesting that Mir had violated his bail conditions.The high court said that, considering the peculiar facts and circumstances, there was no reason to interfere with the bail order.“Be that as it may, in the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case, this Court does not find any reason to interfere. The present petition is found to be without merit and the same is, accordingly, dismissed,” it further added.The high court accordingly dismissed the Union Territory’s petition challenging the bail.

articles.title: Argentinian judge orders suspension of Falklands oil project
articles.summary: The symbolic move comes as Argentina escalates its claim over the British-administered territory.
articles.body:
An Argentinian judge has ordered the suspension of a British-Israeli oil project near the Falkland Islands in a purely symbolic move as Argentina escalates its claim over the British-administered territory.

Wednesday’s interim ruling issued by a court in Argentina’s southernmost province, Tierra del Fuego, follows a lawsuit filed by 1982 war veterans and environmental lawyers earlier this month.

The plaintiffs sought to block Britain’s Rockhopper Exploration and Israel’s Navitas Petroleum from the Sea Lion oilfield, located about 220km (137 miles) from the islands.

The judge ordered the companies to “refrain from initiating, pursuing, carrying out or having carried out any material actions” that would involve drilling, installing infrastructure or extracting hydrocarbons, according to a ruling seen by the AFP news agency.

Additionally, the suspension applies “until such time as the environmental impact assessment procedure has been conducted before the national authority competent in environmental matters”.

The judge gave the parties 10 days to provide information, including details about the status of the project, its contractors and its financiers.

President Javier Milei’s administration has also taken legal action against the project, arguing it violates a United Nations resolution calling for both sides to desist from unilateral actions in the islands until their dispute is resolved.

The court order comes just a day after Argentina announced it would file further legal complaints against companies exploring for oil near the islands, intensifying its campaign against businesses operating in the British overseas territory.

Britain and Argentina fought a brief but bitter 10-week war in 1982 over the South Atlantic islands, known to Argentines as the Malvinas.

The 1982 war ended with an Argentinian surrender after 74 days of conflict that killed 649 Argentines and 255 British troops, as well as three Falkland Islanders.

Buenos Aires has doubled down on its claim over the Falkland Islands after US President Donald Trump said Washington was open to reviewing its historically neutral stance on the territory.

London maintains the islands are British and rejects the jurisdiction of Argentinian courts in the Falklands.

The islanders themselves voted overwhelmingly in 2013 to remain British.

But Argentina rejects that outcome, arguing that the principle of self-determination does not apply to a population it considers implanted by Britain after 1833.
